title: A look ahead to next week: A tale of two markets

observed_trades.setup: Bought IBIT near the lows as a Weinstein-style stage 4B-minus setup.
observed_trades.quote: I bought I bit way down here as a stage 4B minus setup
observed_trades.notes: Pointing at the chart; no date.

observed_trades.setup: Added to the IBIT position later on the chart; it has been acting great.
observed_trades.quote: and then I added to it right here and this thing has been acting great
observed_trades.notes: Pointing at the chart; no date. Ticker named in the preceding sentence.

observed_trades.setup: Bought Okta on a breakout; calls it one of his cybersecurity names and shrugs off Friday's down day.
observed_trades.quote: octa I bought on this breakout. So far so good.
observed_trades.notes: No date in this sentence. At 00:42 he says 'I ended up buying it the the very next day, on Monday the 14th' with an unclear 'it' (Okta or Dell) - not used to date this row; see ambiguous_tickers.

observed_trades.setup: Bought AMD on a pullback on the 14th; working well.
observed_trades.quote: AMD I bought on the pullback a couple of the 14th and that's working well.
observed_trades.notes: Caption garbled ('a couple of the 14th'). September 14th, 2026 was a Monday.

observed_trades.setup: Picked up TNA on Thursday as small caps reclaimed the 200-day.
observed_trades.quote: I did pick up some TNA effectively on Thursday using kind of that reclaim of the 200 as my guide
observed_trades.notes: TNA = 3x small caps, underlying logged as IWM.

observed_trades.setup: Tried Dell on Thursday on a pullback into the rising 20-day.
observed_trades.quote: then Dell and I bought this one again on I tried it on Thursday
observed_trades.notes: Did not keep it that day (next row). 'again' suggests an earlier Dell trade not described here.

observed_trades.setup: Thursday's attempt did not close well enough to keep.
observed_trades.quote: I tried buying it on Thursday, it just didn't close well enough for me to keep.
observed_trades.notes: Ticker named earlier in the same block (01:13-01:23).

observed_trades.setup: Rebought Dell on Friday; a nice day followed.
observed_trades.quote: I rebought it back on Friday, and a pretty nice day out of Dell.

observed_trades.setup: Tried to buy PANW on Wednesday; it pushed out nicely, then round-tripped.
observed_trades.quote: PanW again a little bit of a shaky bastard but I tried to buy this one on Wednesday
observed_trades.notes: Wednesday is two sessions before the Friday session, so flagged retrospective by the brief's rule although it is the same week.

observed_trades.setup: Cut at roughly flat after the push round-tripped.
observed_trades.quote: it pushed out nicely and then it round trip so I had to cut it effectively at flat
observed_trades.notes: Exit day not stated (some time Wednesday to Friday). Ticker named in the preceding clause.

ambiguous_tickers.caption_text: I ended up buying it the the very next day, on Monday the 14th
ambiguous_tickers.context: Unclear which name 'it' is: said while discussing Okta's down day and comparing it to Dell; AMD is separately said to be bought on 'the 14th' at 12:10. No separate row logged.
